title: Air Force lieutenant colonel ran ARV test program at Edwards 412th Test Wing
place_text: Edwards Air Force Base; Nevada Test and Training Range

tellings.quote: I'm familiar with a Air Force Lieutenant Colonel out there who claims to have run a um a program that was focused on testing alien reproduction vehicles and derivative technology.

plain: A commentator who goes by the online name UAPGerb (UAP is the government's term for UFOs) told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, in 2026 that he knows of an Air Force lieutenant colonel who claims to have run a secret test program. According to UAPGerb, the program ran from about 1998 to 2008 within the 412th Test Wing, a flight-testing unit at Edwards Air Force Base in California, with links to the Nevada Test and Training Range, a large military range in Nevada. He says it tested "alien reproduction vehicles," human-built copies of alien craft, and technology based on them, which if true would mean the Air Force has been flying copied alien technology.
